category_description: Savings, interest rates and investing in New Zealand.
subcategory_description: How the interest on bank accounts and term deposits is taxed.
label: RWT rate: lowest income band
context: The rate an individual can choose if their total taxable income is in the lowest band, up to the first band limit. It applies to interest from bank accounts and investments.

label: RWT rate: second income band
context: The rate an individual can choose if their total taxable income is above the lowest band limit and up to the second.

label: RWT rate: third income band
context: The rate an individual can choose if their total taxable income is above the second band limit and up to the third.

label: RWT rate: fourth income band
context: The rate an individual can choose if their total taxable income is above the third band limit and up to the fourth.

label: RWT rate: top income band
context: The rate an individual can choose if their total taxable income is above the fourth band limit.

label: Income band limit: 10.5% to 17.5%
context: Total taxable income up to this amount is in the lowest RWT band.

label: Income band limit: 17.5% to 30%
context: Total taxable income above the first band limit and up to this amount is in the second band.

label: Income band limit: 30% to 33%
context: Total taxable income above the second band limit and up to this amount is in the third band.

label: Income band limit: 33% to 39%
context: Total taxable income above the third band limit and up to this amount is in the fourth band. Income above it is in the top band.

label: Default RWT rate for individuals
context: The rate deducted from an individual's interest if they have given their IRD number but have not chosen a rate.

label: RWT rate without an IRD number
context: The non-declaration rate: deducted from interest paid to someone who has not given their IRD number to the payer. It has applied from 1 April 2020.

label: Default RWT rate for companies
context: The rate deducted if a company has given its IRD number and company status but has not chosen a rate. A company can choose 28%, 33% or 39%.

label: RWT rate on dividends
context: The rate the paying company deducts from dividends paid to a New Zealand resident. Portfolio investment entities are taxed at different rates depending on the type of fund.

subject_intro: How resident withholding tax works on New Zealand bank interest: the rates an individual can choose, what happens if they do not choose, and who is exempt.
subject_meta_description: How resident withholding tax is taken from New Zealand bank interest, the five rates an individual can choose, the default rate and exemptions.
